items.title: Peter Bocage Interview, 1962-02-06
items.q: The old man. I told you, a fellow at the theater, yeah. That's right. Yeah. Called Dusty, fine drummer, show man, you know.

ctx.x: Who taught him to play? Who?
The old man. I told you, a fellow at the theater, yeah. That's right. Yeah. Called Dusty, fine drummer, show man, you know.
What kind of stuff did he play in the Pierron band, Cattrall? Lewis Cattrall. What kind of stuff did he play? Four four rhythms? No, he was strictly, he played by music, you know. Strict by music?
